title: MilestoneCatalog
description: Data file content/milestones/catalog.json (B2598, D827 R12/R35, A1583/A1625): what counts as a milestone of the world. A milestone is reached the first time the inhabitants make a thing whose type has all properties of made_with (by building or by using things together), or the first time a rule of the data (combination or process rule) applies. The core recognises it itself, once per world, with tick and maker; the order is not given here, it follows from what the world allows. A milestone may raise the world's tech level: the reached tech level is the highest of the start level (content/invention/settings.json tech_level) and those of the reached milestones. Nothing in the code names a milestone.

Milestone.description: One milestone. Exactly one of made_with and rule is set (checked at load).

text_key.description: Text key of the milestone's name (DE/EN in content/i18n).

made_with.description: Property ids (vocabulary property) the made thing's type must all have, by the world's truth.

rule.description: Id of a combination rule (content/rules) or process rule (content/processes) whose first use is the milestone.

raises_tech_level.description: Tech level (vocabulary tech_level) the world reaches with this milestone; omitted = none.
